annotation.title_clean: 市场监管总局关于进一步贯彻实施《中华人民共和国反不正当竞争法》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the State Administration for Market Regulation on Further Implementing the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the PRC
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家市场监督管理总局 (State Administration for Market Regulation)
annotation.summary_en: SAMR notice (No. 40, 25 March 2026) directing local regulators on implementing the revised Anti-Unfair Competition Law effective 15 Oct 2025. It covers involution-style competition, platform algorithm abuses, late payments to SMEs, data and trade secret protection, extraterritorial enforcement and compliance guidance. AI is mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Curb 'involution' competition in platforms, photovoltaics, lithium batteries and new-energy vehicles
Penalise platforms forcing below-cost sales via algorithms and search ranking
Address large firms' late payments to SMEs
Strengthen data-rights and trade secret protection, including for emerging industries like AI
Explore extraterritorial enforcement and draft Regulations on Prohibiting Online Unfair Competition
